_comment: The maze's DEFAULT content pack (content sets R2): one pack concept per mechanic concept the maze realises. Each presents that concept and carries the `look` (colour + symbol) the maze writes into a world's payload at generation. A gate (the `gate` role) also takes its `name`; an item (the `item` role) keeps its AP item name, which is logic, so only its look is written. What a gate or a pickup DOES is the substrate's code (mazeConcepts.js).

maze:object/sword.name: Progressive Sword
maze:object/sword.description: A blade keen enough to fell the guardian.

maze:object/swim.name: Progressive Swim
maze:object/swim.description: The knack of swimming, for crossing deep water.

maze:character/guardian.name: Guardian
maze:character/guardian.description: A guardian that bars a tile until it is fought with a sword.

maze:object/water.name: Water
maze:object/water.description: Deep water that floods a tile until it is crossed by swimming.
